observations.behavior: Adds a new optional parameter `transcriptTailWindow` to CloudTaskEngine, used to limit the number of entries fetched from the session logs. P1.F4.H16 adds a new method `fetchSessionLogsWindow` that uses this window to avoid fetching the entire log, while P1.F4.H11 and P1.F4.H12 adjust the calculation of the total entry count and the emitted snapshot. observations.posthog_connection: Changes the CloudTaskEngine to account for a window start when calculating the total entry count, and to emit the window start in the snapshot. This could help the desktop renderer understand that not all entries are available and that older entries are not included.
